The complete tab tree is validated all-or-nothing before any tab strip, panel, host, or reserved geometry is emitted; the renderer does not filter, reorder, invent, or locally persist a tab selection.

implementation: presentationTabs resolves every canonical TabLayoutNode contribution ID in source order through the exact keyed contribution map and trusted renderer registry; a missing or untrusted member rejects the complete tab node instead of filtering a valid prefix or creating a substitute tab.
renderActiveChild requires the generated active_contribution_id to match one of the resolved canonical tab members. It does not use a local active index or fallback contribution.

The tab strip exposes only actual resolved contributions, preserves Core order, marks the canonical active child, and renders only that active contribution panel. No absent contribution receives a button, heading, border, panel, or geometry.

presentationTab.select forwards only an exact resolved contribution ID and never mutates LayoutNode, active state, projection revisions, or local layout memory. The parent Desktop runtime owns the generated mutation path.

The production MissionCanvasRenderer -> MissionCanvasFrame -> recursive ProjectionLayoutRenderer path is exercised in addition to the focused recursive harness; recursive calls retain the supplied trusted registry and callback.

negative_cases.canonical_order_and_active_child: A valid canonical tabs tree emits exactly two actual tab buttons in contribution_ids order, marks contribution:pi-session active, and renders only its panel; the inspector contribution receives no panel host until Core returns it as active.
negative_cases.omitted_or_empty_contribution: An omitted tab ID, an omitted active ID, or an empty/malformed tab list rejects the complete Tabs node before layout-tabs, tab-list, tab, tabpanel, contribution host, heading, border, or reserved geometry output. The renderer does not reflow or invent a replacement.
negative_cases.foreign_keyed_contribution: A contribution whose DTO contribution_id differs from its map key is rejected by the exact lookup and recursive validation; no tab is repaired or rendered under the foreign key.
negative_cases.unknown_renderer_or_semantic_binding: An unknown renderer binding or non-allowlisted semantic binding is rejected by the trusted registry before any tab geometry is emitted; no generic or substitute renderer is used.
negative_cases.missing_authority: Deleting a ResolvedContribution AuthorityDescriptor makes trusted resolution fail and leaves no tab tree or contribution host.
negative_cases.foreign_workstream_attachment: The generated MissionCanvasProjectionController and event/transport seams reject foreign projection, contribution, event, and WorkSurface authority before canonical projection data reaches the renderer; UI-010 adds no client-local scope inference or repair.
negative_cases.stale_revision_or_cursor: Projection-controller and invalidation hostile cases reject regressed projection/layout revisions, stale cursors, and cursor namespace mismatches, preserving the prior canonical projection rather than rendering a guessed tab state.
negative_cases.unavailable_capability: When the generated layout mutation callback is absent, rendered tabs remain disabled/inert. The Desktop runtime supplies onSelectTab only when the generated focusa.mission_canvas.layout.mutate binding is enabled; operation-unavailable and permission failures remain transport/Core failures.
negative_cases.ineligible_or_empty_contribution: Core omission diagnostics and the canonical eligible contribution map determine occupancy. A contribution omitted for no_relevant_content cannot receive a tab, and the renderer does not create an empty panel or preserve a dead slot.
negative_cases.local_mutation: The tab renderer contains no local active-index state, resize control, layout store, or canonical mutation. DesktopMissionCanvasRuntime invokes the generated MissionCanvasClient.layoutMutate path with set_active_tab, exact authority, expected revisions, and idempotency fields.

acceptance: Tab selection changes presentation only and no absent contribution receives a tab.
Omitted contribution IDs cannot leave DOM nodes, headings, borders, or gaps.
Unknown semantic or renderer binding fails closed; no substitute panel is rendered.
Resize mutations call focusa.mission_canvas.layout.mutate rather than changing canonical layout locally.
